# Success Starts Within

> Mental performance coaching and sport psychology services for athletes of all levels, led by AASP-certified coach Eli Straw.

Success Starts Within specializes in helping athletes overcome performance anxiety, build mental toughness, and develop competition mindsets through 1-on-1 coaching, group courses, and educational content. The platform serves youth athletes through adults across all sports.

## Key Topics

- mental performance coaching

## Core Coaching Programs

- [Mental Performance Coaching for Athletes](https://www.successstartswithin.com/mental-performance-coaching): Main 1-on-1 mental performance coaching program with personalized sessions by Eli Straw.
- [Confident Competitor Academy](https://www.successstartswithin.com/confident-competitor-academy): 6-week mental training course for athletes to overcome anxiety and build confidence.
- [The Mentally Tough Kid](https://www.successstartswithin.com/the-mentally-tough-kid): Mental toughness course designed for youth athletes ages 9-14.
- [Get Coaching](https://www.successstartswithin.com/get-coaching): Sign up for a free introductory mental performance coaching call with Coach Eli.

## Educational Content & Resources

- [Sports Psychology Articles](https://www.successstartswithin.com/sports-psychology-articles): Collection of articles on mental performance, athlete confidence, and sport psychology.
- [Sports Psychology Videos](https://www.successstartswithin.com/sports-psychology-videos): Video library of mental training tools and techniques for athlete performance.
- [The Sports Psychology Coaching Podcast](https://www.successstartswithin.com/sports-psychology-podcast): Weekly podcast by Eli Straw on mental coaching for athletes, available on Spotify and YouTube.
